request.style: English, young male voice, solo with choir, acoustic guitar, drums, cello, trumpet, majestic and hopeful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the eighteenth year, Jeroboam reigned
Abijah became king over Judah
Three years he ruled from Jerusalem
His mother was Maacah of Gibeah
War broke out between the divided lands
Jeroboam rose up in rebellion

[Chorus]
The LORD gave kingship to David
Forever, by a covenant of salt
Do not fight against the God of Israel
You cannot succeed in this battle

[Verse]
Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim
In the hill country of Ephraim
He called out to all Israel
Hear me, Jeroboam and the tribes
You have golden calves for gods
You drove out the priests of Aaron

[Chorus]
The LORD gave kingship to David
Forever, by a covenant of salt
Do not fight against the God of Israel
You cannot succeed in this battle

[Verse]
We keep the charge of the LORD our God
Burnt offerings morning and evening
The priests serve with trumpets ready
Sound the battle cry against you
Four hundred thousand chosen men
Against eight hundred mighty warriors

[Bridge]
Judah cried out to the LORD
The priests blew the trumpets loud
God struck down Jeroboam
Five hundred thousand men fell slain

[Chorus]
The LORD gave kingship to David
Forever, by a covenant of salt
Do not fight against the God of Israel
You cannot succeed in this battle

[Outro]
Abijah captured Bethel and Jeshanah
He took fourteen wives and twenty-two sons
